title: Kurian Mathew Abraham vs Teuny Johns on 4 November, 2009

paragraphs.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM

WP(C).No. 16439 of 2009(R)


1. KURIAN MATHEW ABRAHAM, AGED 32,
 ... Petitioner

 Vs



1. TEUNY JOHNS, AGED 27 YEARS,
 ... Respondent

 For Petitioner :SRI.S.MUHAMMED HANEEFF

 For Respondent :SRI.SAJAN MANNALI

The Hon'ble MR. Justice R.BASANT
The Hon'ble MRS. Justice M.C.HARI RANI

 Dated :04/11/2009

 O R D E R
 R.BASANT & M.C.HARI RANI, JJ.
 * * * * * * * * * * * * *
 W.P.(C).No.16439 of 2009
 ----------------------------------------
 Dated this the 4th day of November 2009


 J U D G M E N T

Basant,J

 This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner who is the

respondent in O.P.No.254/06 pending before the Family Court,

Ernakulam. This petition has been filed to challenge Ext.P5

order.

2. During the pendency of the proceedings, parties have

settled all their outstanding disputes. It is submitted before

court that O.P.No.254/06 for divorce as also O.P.No.1669/06

claiming a money decree pending between the parties before the

Family Court have all now been settled. Parties have agreed

that the marital tie can be dissolved by an application under

 Section 10A of the Divorce Act. They have further agreed to pay

a lump sum amount of Rs.3,00,000/- in full settlement of the

monetary claims. It is submitted at the Bar that the amount has

already been paid.

3. It is prayed that an order granting divorce by mutual

consent under Section 10A of the Divorce Act may be passed by

W.P.C No.16439/09 2

this court in this writ petition and that O.P.No.1669/06 may be

dismissed by an order in this writ petition. I.A.No.13836/09

has been filed before this court to report such settlement and

I.A.No.13837/09 has been filed for an order dissolving marriage

under Section 10A of the Divorce Act by mutual consent.

4. We wanted the learned counsel to explain why they

have not moved the Family Court, Ernakulam before which O.Ps

are pending and why they have come before this court with these

I.As. The learned counsel submit that there have been

precedents where such course has been followed by this court.

In the interests of justice and for expeditious and harmonious

settlement of the disputes between parties, such an

extraordinary course may be followed by this court, it is prayed.

5. Having rendered our anxious consideration, we are

not persuaded to agree that these I.As need be disposed of by

this court. It will only be appropriate to direct the parties to

appear before the Family Court where the divorce petition and

the application for return of money are pending and report the

composition before the Family Court so that the Family Court

can pass appropriate orders. Not that this court does not have

jurisdictional competence to resort to such an extraordinary

W.P.C No.16439/09 3

course in an appropriate case; but we are not persuaded to agree

that, in the facts and circumstances of this case, such course

deserves to be followed.
a) This writ petition is dismissed.

b) I.A.Nos.13836 & 13837 of 2009 shall be returned to

the petitioners to seek appropriate remedy before the Family

Court before which the O.Ps are pending.

7. The learned counsel pray and it is directed that the

Family Court, Ernakulam must pass appropriate orders

expeditiously in O.P.Nos.254/06 and 1669/06 when settlement is

reported by advancing the hearing of the said O.Ps, if necessary.

(R.BASANT, JUDGE)



 (M.C.HARI RANI, JUDGE)
